        }

        /* ===========================================
           REVEAL ANIMATIONS
           Triggered by .visible class via IntersectionObserver
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo),
                        transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0; transform: translateX(calc(-1 * clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px)));
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo), transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo), transform var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }

        /* Stagger delays */
        .d1 { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
        .d2 { transition-delay: 0.18s; }
        .d3 { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .d4 { transition-delay: 0.38s; }
        .d5 { transition-delay: 0.48s; }
        .d6 { transition-delay: 0.58s; }
        .d7 { transition-delay: 0.68s; }
        .d8 { transition-delay: 0.78s; }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED COMPONENT: SLIDE HEADER BAND
           Thin top bar with slide label + number
           =========================================== */
        .slide-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem) var(--slide-padding);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .slide-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .slide-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED COMPONENT: ACCENT LINE
           Decorative teal rule under headings
           =========================================== */
        .accent-line {
            width: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), transparent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem) 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SHARED COMPONENT: TAG / BADGE
           =========================================== */
        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: 0.2em 0.7em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.08);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }
        .tag.amber { color: var(--accent-amber); border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3); background: rgba(245,166,35,0.08); }
        .tag.blue  { color: var(--accent-blue);  border-color: rgba(61,122,237,0.3); background: rgba(61,122,237,0.08); }
        .tag.green { color: var(--accent-green); border-color: rgba(62,207,142,0.3); background: rgba(62,207,142,0.08); }
        .tag.red   { color: var(--accent-red);   border-color: rgba(224,82,82,0.3);  background: rgba(224,82,82,0.08); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1 — TITLE
           Full-bleed dark hero with glow accent
           =========================================== */
        #s1 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 10% 90%, rgba(0,200,170,0.12) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 10%, rgba(61,122,237,0.1) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-deep);
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .title-eyebrow {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .title-main {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.08;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 16ch;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 2vh, 1.2rem);
        }
        .title-main .accent-word {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }
        .title-subtitle {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 55ch;
            line-height: 1.6;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vh, 1.8rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .title-meta .tag { flex-shrink: 0; }

        /* Corner accent — decorative large circle */
        .corner-glow {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(200px, 40vw, 600px);
            height: clamp(200px, 40vw, 600px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,200,170,0.06) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,170,0.08);
            right: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 160px));
            top: calc(-1 * clamp(80px, 12vw, 160px));
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .corner-glow2 {
            position: absolute;
            width: clamp(120px, 22vw, 320px);
            height: clamp(120px, 22vw, 320px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(61,122,237,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(61,122,237,0.06);
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px));
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px));
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
           Two-panel: stat cards left, text right
           =========================================== */
        #s2 { background: var(--bg-panel); }
        .problem-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .stat-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
        }
        .stat-card.warn { border-left-color: var(--accent-red); }
        .stat-card.amber { border-left-color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stat-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .stat-card.warn .stat-num { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .stat-card.amber .stat-num { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }
        .problem-text h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .bullet-items {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .bullet-items li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding-left: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            position: relative;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .bullet-items li::before {
            content: '›';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .bullet-items li strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .problem-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .stat-stack { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — ARCHITECTURE
           Horizontal pipeline flow diagram
           =========================================== */
        #s3 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(61,122,237,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
                var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            max-width: 100%;
        }
        .pipe-step {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .pipe-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            min-width: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px);
        }
        .pipe-box.highlight {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.06);
        }
        .pipe-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }
        .pipe-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .pipe-detail {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .pipe-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            align-self: center;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.4rem);
        }
        .pipe-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.62rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px);
        }
        .arch-findings {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .finding-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .finding-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — COMPUTE ALLOCATION
           Bar chart: encoder size vs. performance
           =========================================== */
        #s4 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(245,166,35,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-panel);
        }
        .compute-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .chart-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .chart-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }
        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(5rem, 10vw, 10rem) 1fr clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .bar-track {
            height: clamp(12px, 2.5vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .bar-fill.small { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), rgba(0,200,170,0.5)); }
        .bar-fill.large { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), rgba(245,166,35,0.5)); }
        .bar-fill.large2 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(61,122,237,0.5)); }
        .bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: left;
        }
        .separator-line {
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) 0;
        }
        .compute-insight {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .insight-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-teal {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.05);
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-amber {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3);
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.05);
        }
        .insight-head {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-amber .insight-head { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .insight-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .insight-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — TOKEN COMPRESSION
           Visual pixel-shuffle diagram
           =========================================== */
        #s5 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(61,122,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .token-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        /* Pixel shuffle visual */
        .shuffle-visual {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .shuffle-step-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        /* Input grid: 4×4 spatial cells */
        .grid-vis {
            display: grid;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .grid-vis.input-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 1fr);
            width: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px);
            height: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px);
        }
        .grid-vis.output-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            width: clamp(50px, 9vw, 92px);
            height: clamp(50px, 9vw, 92px);
        }
        .grid-cell {
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,170,0.08);
        }
        .grid-cell.c0 { background: rgba(0,200,170,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c1 { background: rgba(61,122,237,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c2 { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c3 { background: rgba(224,82,82,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c0.deep { background: rgba(0,200,170,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c1.deep { background: rgba(61,122,237,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c2.deep { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c3.deep { background: rgba(224,82,82,0.5); }
        .shuffle-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }
        .shuffle-metrics {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }
        .metric-pill {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .metric-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .metric-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .token-info {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .r-compare {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .r-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .r-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            background: var(--bg-card2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 5px;
            padding: 0.2em 0.4em;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }
        .r-badge.dim { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .r-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .r-desc strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — CONTEXT LENGTH SCALING
           =========================================== */
        #s6 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 20%, rgba(62,207,142,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-panel);
        }
        .context-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .context-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .context-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .ctx-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
            width: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 7rem);
            text-align: right;
        }
        .ctx-bar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(16px, 3vh, 28px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .ctx-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding-left: 0.5em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-expo) 0.3s;
        }
        .ctx-bar.before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a5568, #6b7280); width: 12.5%; }
        .ctx-bar.after8  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), rgba(0,200,170,0.7)); width: 50%; }
        .ctx-bar.after16 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(61,122,237,0.7)); width: 100%; }
        .ctx-note {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.65vw, 0.58rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .context-facts {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .fact-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .fact-head {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-green);
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
        .fact-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .fact-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .rope-vis {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .rope-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .rope-arrow-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 2px;

<!-- ============================================================
     JAVASCRIPT: SlidePresentation Controller
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
    /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER: add .visible when slide enters viewport === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch(e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageDown': e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageUp':   e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(0); break;
                    case 'End':  e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    delta > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }, { passive: false });
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.updateProgressBar();
        }
        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === NAVIGATION DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }
        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
        }

        /* === SLIDE NAVIGATION METHODS === */
        nextSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide < this.slides.length - 1) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
            }
        }
        prevSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
            }
        }
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.currentSlide = index;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.updateProgressBar();
            this.updateNavDots();
        }
    }

    /* === BAR CHART ANIMATION: animate bars when slide becomes visible === */
    const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const bars = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill, .ctx-bar, .tp-bar-fill');
                bars.forEach(bar => {
                    const target = bar.style.width;
                    bar.style.width = '0%';
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.width = target; });
                    });
                });
                barObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });

    document.querySelectorAll('#s4, #s6, #s8').forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));

    /* === INIT === */
    const presentation = new SlidePresentation();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
    /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER: add .visible when slide enters viewport === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch(e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageDown': e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageUp':   e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(0); break;
                    case 'End':  e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    delta > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }, { passive: false });
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.updateProgressBar();
        }
        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === NAVIGATION DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }
        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
        }

        /* === SLIDE NAVIGATION METHODS === */
        nextSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide < this.slides.length - 1) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
            }
        }
        prevSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
            }
        }
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.currentSlide = index;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.updateProgressBar();
            this.updateNavDots();
        }
    }

    /* === BAR CHART ANIMATION: animate bars when slide becomes visible === */
    const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const bars = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill, .ctx-bar, .tp-bar-fill');
                bars.forEach(bar => {
                    const target = bar.style.width;
                    bar.style.width = '0%';
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.width = target; });
                    });
                });
                barObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });

    document.querySelectorAll('#s4, #s6, #s8').forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));

    /* === INIT === */
    const presentation = new SlidePresentation();
</script>

</body>
</html>

        :root {

            width: clamp(120px, 22vw, 320px);
            height: clamp(120px, 22vw, 320px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(61,122,237,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(61,122,237,0.06);
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px));
            bottom: calc(-1 * clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px));
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2 — PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
           Two-panel: stat cards left, text right
           =========================================== */
        #s2 { background: var(--bg-panel); }
        .problem-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .stat-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
        }
        .stat-card.warn { border-left-color: var(--accent-red); }
        .stat-card.amber { border-left-color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stat-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .stat-card.warn .stat-num { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .stat-card.amber .stat-num { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 0.2em;
        }
        .problem-text h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .bullet-items {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .bullet-items li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding-left: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.4rem);
            position: relative;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .bullet-items li::before {
            content: '›';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .bullet-items li strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .problem-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
            .stat-stack { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3 — ARCHITECTURE
           Horizontal pipeline flow diagram
           =========================================== */
        #s3 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 50%, rgba(61,122,237,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
                var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            max-width: 100%;
        }
        .pipe-step {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .pipe-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            min-width: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px);
        }
        .pipe-box.highlight {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.06);
        }
        .pipe-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-bottom: 0.2em;
        }
        .pipe-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .pipe-detail {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .pipe-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            align-self: center;
            padding-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.4rem);
        }
        .pipe-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.62rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: clamp(70px, 9vw, 120px);
        }
        .arch-findings {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .finding-text {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .finding-text strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4 — COMPUTE ALLOCATION
           Bar chart: encoder size vs. performance
           =========================================== */
        #s4 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(245,166,35,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-panel);
        }
        .compute-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .chart-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .chart-title {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }
        .bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .bar-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(5rem, 10vw, 10rem) 1fr clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.5rem);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }
        .bar-track {
            height: clamp(12px, 2.5vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-expo);
        }
        .bar-fill.small { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), rgba(0,200,170,0.5)); }
        .bar-fill.large { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-amber), rgba(245,166,35,0.5)); }
        .bar-fill.large2 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(61,122,237,0.5)); }
        .bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-align: left;
        }
        .separator-line {
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--border);
            margin: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) 0;
        }
        .compute-insight {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .insight-block {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-teal {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.05);
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-amber {
            border-color: rgba(245,166,35,0.3);
            background: rgba(245,166,35,0.05);
        }
        .insight-head {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .insight-block.highlight-amber .insight-head { color: var(--accent-amber); }
        .insight-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .insight-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5 — TOKEN COMPRESSION
           Visual pixel-shuffle diagram
           =========================================== */
        #s5 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(61,122,237,0.09) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .token-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        /* Pixel shuffle visual */
        .shuffle-visual {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .shuffle-step-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        /* Input grid: 4×4 spatial cells */
        .grid-vis {
            display: grid;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .grid-vis.input-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(8, 1fr);
            width: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px);
            height: clamp(100px, 18vw, 180px);
        }
        .grid-vis.output-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            width: clamp(50px, 9vw, 92px);
            height: clamp(50px, 9vw, 92px);
        }
        .grid-cell {
            border: 1px solid rgba(0,200,170,0.08);
        }
        .grid-cell.c0 { background: rgba(0,200,170,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c1 { background: rgba(61,122,237,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c2 { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c3 { background: rgba(224,82,82,0.25); }
        .grid-cell.c0.deep { background: rgba(0,200,170,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c1.deep { background: rgba(61,122,237,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c2.deep { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.5); }
        .grid-cell.c3.deep { background: rgba(224,82,82,0.5); }
        .shuffle-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }
        .shuffle-metrics {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }
        .metric-pill {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .metric-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .metric-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.7vw, 0.6rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 0.2em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .token-info {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .r-compare {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .r-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .r-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            background: var(--bg-card2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 5px;
            padding: 0.2em 0.4em;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }
        .r-badge.dim { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .r-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .r-desc strong { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6 — CONTEXT LENGTH SCALING
           =========================================== */
        #s6 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 20%, rgba(62,207,142,0.07) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-panel);
        }
        .context-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .context-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .context-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .ctx-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
            width: clamp(4rem, 7vw, 7rem);
            text-align: right;
        }
        .ctx-bar-wrap {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(16px, 3vh, 28px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .ctx-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding-left: 0.5em;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.68rem);
            color: rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-expo) 0.3s;
        }
        .ctx-bar.before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a5568, #6b7280); width: 12.5%; }
        .ctx-bar.after8  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), rgba(0,200,170,0.7)); width: 50%; }
        .ctx-bar.after16 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), rgba(61,122,237,0.7)); width: 100%; }
        .ctx-note {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.65vw, 0.58rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .context-facts {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .fact-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .fact-head {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-green);
            margin-bottom: 0.25em;
        }
        .fact-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .fact-body strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
        .rope-vis {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card2);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .rope-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .rope-arrow-line {
            flex: 1;
            height: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #4a5568, var(--accent-green));
            position: relative;
        }
        .rope-arrow-line::after {
            content: '▶';
            position: absolute;
            right: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            font-size: 0.6em;
        }
        .rope-new {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-green);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7 — BENCHMARK PERFORMANCE
           Full data table
           =========================================== */
        #s7 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 90%, rgba(0,200,170,0.06) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-deep);
        }
        .bench-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            flex-shrink: 1;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.78rem);
        }
        .bench-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.48rem, 0.75vw, 0.68rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bench-table th:first-child,
        .bench-table th:nth-child(2) { text-align: left; }
        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.45rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bench-table td:first-child { text-align: left; }
        .bench-table td:nth-child(2) {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 500;
            text-align: left;
        }
        .bench-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
        .bench-table .section-header td {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.68vw, 0.6rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            text-align: left;
            padding: clamp(0.15rem, 0.35vh, 0.3rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .bench-table .avg-row td {
            background: rgba(0,200,170,0.05);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .bench-table .avg-row td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .val-best { color: var(--accent-green) !important; font-weight: 700; }
        .val-256m { color: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.78rem); color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .val-ram {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.48rem, 0.72vw, 0.64rem);

        .ram-row td { background: rgba(61,122,237,0.04); border-top: 1px solid rgba(61,122,237,0.15); }
        .ram-row td:nth-child(2) { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .bench-summary {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .bench-sum-card {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: clamp(80px, 14vw, 130px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 0.9vh, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .bsc-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .bsc-val.t  { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .bsc-val.b  { color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .bsc-val.g  { color: var(--accent-green); }
        .bsc-val.r  { color: var(--accent-red); }
        .bsc-label {
            font-size: clamp(0.45rem, 0.7vw, 0.62rem);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: 0.2em;
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8 — ON-DEVICE DEPLOYMENT
           =========================================== */
        #s8 {
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(62,207,142,0.08) 0%, transparent 55%),
                var(--bg-panel);
        }
        .device-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .throughput-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.7rem);
        }
        .tp-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: clamp(7rem, 12vw, 11rem) 1fr clamp(3rem, 4.5vw, 4.5rem);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;

                </div>

                    <div class="fact-head">Why context length matters for vision</div>
                    <div class="fact-body">
                        Higher resolution images produce more visual tokens. Without sufficient context length, high-resolution inputs must be downsampled or truncated — degrading OCR, chart reading, and document understanding.
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="fact-card">
                    <div class="fact-head">Technical strategy</div>
                    <div class="fact-body">
                        <strong>RoPE base: 10K → 273K</strong> (27× increase) enables the positional encoding to generalize to sequences far beyond the original training length. Combined with mixed-context fine-tuning, this preserves performance on short sequences while unlocking long-context capability.
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="fact-card">
                    <div class="fact-head">Model-specific context windows</div>
                    <div class="fact-body">
                        <strong>SmolVLM-2.2B:</strong> 16K token context<br>
                        <strong>SmolVLM-256M / 500M:</strong> 8K token context<br>
                        Smaller models use 8K to balance memory and resolution needs.
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="fact-card">
                    <div class="fact-head">Impact on benchmarks</div>
                    <div class="fact-body">
                        Performance improves <strong>significantly</strong> when extending from 2K to the model's full context window — especially on document-heavy tasks (DocVQA, OCRBench) that benefit most from higher effective resolution.

                </div>
            </div>

     JAVASCRIPT: SlidePresentation Controller
     ============================================================ -->
<script>
    /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
    class SlidePresentation {
        constructor() {
            this.slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
            this.currentSlide = 0;
            this.isScrolling = false;
            this.touchStartY = 0;

            this.setupIntersectionObserver();
            this.setupKeyboardNav();
            this.setupTouchNav();
            this.setupWheelNav();
            this.setupProgressBar();
            this.setupNavDots();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            this.slides[0].classList.add('visible');
        }

        /* === INTERSECTION OBSERVER: add .visible when slide enters viewport === */
        setupIntersectionObserver() {
            const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                entries.forEach(entry => {
                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                        const idx = this.slides.indexOf(entry.target);
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    }
                });
            }, { threshold: 0.5 });

            this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
        }

        /* === KEYBOARD NAVIGATION === */
        setupKeyboardNav() {
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                switch(e.key) {
                    case 'ArrowDown': case 'ArrowRight': case ' ':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'ArrowUp': case 'ArrowLeft':
                        e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageDown': e.preventDefault(); this.nextSlide(); break;
                    case 'PageUp':   e.preventDefault(); this.prevSlide(); break;
                    case 'Home': e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(0); break;
                    case 'End':  e.preventDefault(); this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1); break;
                }
            });
        }

        /* === TOUCH SWIPE NAVIGATION === */
        setupTouchNav() {
            document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                this.touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            }, { passive: true });

            document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                const delta = this.touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                if (Math.abs(delta) > 50) {
                    delta > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                }
            }, { passive: true });
        }

        /* === MOUSE WHEEL NAVIGATION === */
        setupWheelNav() {
            document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                e.deltaY > 0 ? this.nextSlide() : this.prevSlide();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }, { passive: false });
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        setupProgressBar() {
            this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            this.updateProgressBar();
        }
        updateProgressBar() {
            if (!this.progressBar) return;
            const pct = ((this.currentSlide) / (this.slides.length - 1)) * 100;
            this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        /* === NAVIGATION DOTS === */
        setupNavDots() {
            const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
            if (!nav) return;
            this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                const dot = document.createElement('button');
                dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                nav.appendChild(dot);
            });
        }
        updateNavDots() {
            const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            dots.forEach((dot, i) => dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide));
        }

        /* === SLIDE NAVIGATION METHODS === */
        nextSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide < this.slides.length - 1) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
            }
        }
        prevSlide() {
            if (this.currentSlide > 0) {
                this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
            }
        }
        goToSlide(index) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
            this.currentSlide = index;
            this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            this.updateProgressBar();
            this.updateNavDots();
        }
    }

    /* === BAR CHART ANIMATION: animate bars when slide becomes visible === */
    const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const bars = entry.target.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill, .ctx-bar, .tp-bar-fill');
                bars.forEach(bar => {
                    const target = bar.style.width;
                    bar.style.width = '0%';
                    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                        requestAnimationFrame(() => { bar.style.width = target; });
                    });
                });
                barObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 0.4 });

    document.querySelectorAll('#s4, #s6, #s8').forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));

    /* === INIT === */
    const presentation = new SlidePresentation();
</script>

</body>
</html>
